title: scrumia-practice-tanstack-query — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-practice-tanstack-query: the ScrumIA practices slot — query keys, invalidation, the server/client state boundary.
tagline: One named point of the implementation contract: how the app talks to the server.
responsibilities: Refines data fetching and caching: the queryOptions() factory, query keys, invalidation, optimistic updates, and the boundary that separates server state from client-only state. Ported from real monorepo use — nine guides, thirteen decisions.
refusals: Server state does not get copied into client state, and the module declines to speak for a stack TanStack Query does not ship for.
philosophy: Assumes a stack the library supports — React, Solid, Vue, Svelte. Costs a caching model to learn, and today the audit and refactor skills that would measure the gap are not built yet.
